name: zoo-production-${A}
notes: One production block of one lane: the frozen model (or a baseline) trained on everything before the block's cutoff (less the embargo) and scored out of sample on the block's days. A one-fold walk-forward, so the split, embargo, fit and score are the zoo's own; the block's cutoff and day count come from `block` (generated by crypto_trading.zoo_production). pipeline and objective equal zoo-template.json (a test pins it).

fit.notes: A PanelTrain cell or a baseline: the generator (crypto_trading.zoo_lanes) writes the lane's whole params into args.cell, so this template only places them. Heavy nodes run on the GPU one lane at a time.

score.notes: The common-grid score of the lane's forecaster on the validation band: weighted CRPS (crps + tail_weight * tail_crps), per-horizon CRPS, pinball and PIT in the artifact. Every lane's rows_sha256 must agree.

walkforward.notes: A single fold: `folds` is the block's cutoff, `val_days` is clipped by the generator so the last block ends exactly at evaluate_through.

outputs.notes: Placement only: this lane's run root.
